item.title: [Recap] Victor Wembanyama (SAS): Victor Wembanyama had 32 points (13-of-26 FGs, 4-of-4 FTs), 11 rebounds, three assists, one block, one steal and two three-pointers in the Spurs’ 124-112 victory over the Clippers on Thursday.
item.description:
Victor Wembanyama had 32 points (13-of-26 FGs, 4-of-4 FTs), 11 rebounds, three assists, one block, one steal and two three-pointers in the Spurs’ 124-112 victory over the Clippers on Thursday.

Wembanyama had another excellent game, though he continues to struggle from behind the three-point line. The 22-year-old center is just 3-of-15 from behind the arc over his last two games. Still one of the best players in all of fantasy basketball, Wembanyama’s next chance to break out of his shooting slump will come Saturday against the Pelicans at home.

Nick Shlain

item.title: [Recap] Nikola Jokić (DEN): Nikola Jokić accumulated 28 points (12-of-21 FGs, 2-of-2 FTs), 15 rebounds, seven assists, one steal, one block and two three-pointers in Monday’s loss to the Suns.
item.description:
Nikola Jokić accumulated 28 points (12-of-21 FGs, 2-of-2 FTs), 15 rebounds, seven assists, one steal, one block and two three-pointers in Monday’s loss to the Suns.

The good news for fantasy managers was that Jokić recorded a full stat line on Monday, finishing with his 10th double-double of the season. However, he also committed seven turnovers, matching his season high in that category. By Jokić’s standards, he started slowly, but the Nuggets’ center has remained one of the best players in fantasy basketball, regardless of league format.

Raphielle Johnson
